headline: IDF will not leave a ~700 sq km security zone in south Lebanon until Hezbollah disarmed nationwide
dek: Katz: the IDF has established a ~700 sq km security zone in south Lebanon (Med coast to Beaufort Castle/Ali Taher Ridge/Mt Hermon); 'The IDF will not move from the security zone as long as Hezbollah has not been disarmed throughout Lebanon and the threat to northern residents has not been…
sources: Defense Minister Israel Katz (statement, via Israel National News news/434899, JFeed, RT/Steve Sweeney Beirut report; Haaretz Oct 17 analysis of earlier comments)
fault_line: Does Katz's doctrine make the Tampa talks theater — or does disarmament-first make the zone necessary? Who actually verifies the 'pilot zones'?

sections.what_happened: Katz: the IDF has established a ~700 sq km security zone in south Lebanon (Med coast to Beaufort Castle/Ali Taher Ridge/Mt Hermon); 'The IDF will not move from the security zone as long as Hezbollah has not been disarmed throughout Lebanon and the threat to northern residents has not been removed.' Claimed ~60 villages destroyed (~23,000 homes that 'served as Hezbollah positions'), ~200,000 Shiite residents evacuated up to the Yellow Line, as part of 'Operation Silver Plow'. Warned: if Hezbollah joins an Iranian attack, the IDF is prepared to maneuver toward Nabatieh/Litani areas and any captured territory would be evacuated and permanently become part of the security zone; Dahieh in Beirut treated 'like Avivim, Misgav Am and Kiryat Shmona' for retaliation. Dailytimes247/RT quotes Katz: 'This is the Gaza model, and this is the model we are implementing.' This lands DURING Tampa day-2 talks (Lebanon demands withdrawal + end of ops; Israel demands LAF clear pilot zones; Lebanon rejects direct ops room). INN tag claims 'US rejects Katz's announcement, urges adherence to the agreed security framework' — single-source, unverified.
sections.what_verified: INN (verbatim quotes), JFeed (published timestamp Oct 20 15:58 UTC), RT Beirut video report (dailytimes247), Haaretz Oct 17 premium analysis (earlier version of same doctrine). Village-destruction figures consistent with Naharnet-reported demolitions tracked in prior scans. Tampa day-2 status corroborated in 0600-07 (The National, JPost, Newscord).
sections.what_disputed: The 60-village/23,000-home/200k-displaced figures are Katz's own claims, unverified independently; UN estimated ~330,000 displaced in Lebanon as of late September (dailytimes247). The doctrine openly contradicts the June framework's phased-withdrawal logic — Lebanon calls the strikes the obstruction; Katz calls them the precondition. 'US rejects Katz announcement' remains single-source (INN tag only); hold.
sections.why_matters: The map on the table vs the map on the ground: Tampa day 2 discusses pilot-zone withdrawal while Katz draws a permanent 700 sq km zone — show both on the same south-Lebanon map, named sources on each side. Frame through Lebanon's impossible position: Aoun demands withdrawal, Katz promises permanence.
sections.context: Background: Lebanon — NEW (Oct 20): Katz unveils Lebanon security doctrine: IDF will not leave a ~700 sq km security zone in south Lebanon until Hezbollah disarmed nationwide; 60+ villages/23,000 homes destroyed; threatens Nabatieh/Litani expansion; clashes directly with Tampa day-2 talks

totw_analysis: Our read: The map on the table vs the map on the ground: Tampa day 2 discusses pilot-zone withdrawal while Katz draws a permanent 700 sq km zone — show both on the same south-Lebanon map, named sources on each side. Frame through Lebanon's impossible position: Aoun demands withdrawal, Katz promises permanence. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Does Katz's doctrine make the Tampa talks theater — or does disarmament-first make the zone necessary? Who actually verifies the 'pilot zones'?
